Then, make an attempt to take a trip south. Then, head south. And then, make an effort to travel west. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. Next, move west. And then, attempt to venture north. And then, try to go north. Then, go north. Okay, and then, move north. And then, attempt to go to the east. With that done, make an attempt to go to the east.
